messages:
mike: Observed spike in 502s from router-proxy in eu-west1 starting ~03:10. Root cause looks like the keepalive window change we shipped last night. Connection churn causes failed upstreams for long-lived streams. I have a revert hotfix ready. Requesting expedited prod deploy and optional warm-pool traffic fallback if anything goes sideways. Need ops + eng lead OK to bypass normal canary. /cc @ops-oncall-lee @eng-lead-priya

deploy-bot: Deployment request queued: release/router-proxy-hotfix@v1.4.8 -> prod. Required approvals: [ops, eng]. Approve with `approve deploy 1980011222` or visit https://deploy.local/1980011222

ops-oncall-lee: Blast radius and rollback plan? Any chance we can do a traffic shift to warm-pool instead of full rollback?

mike: Blast radius: dedicated routing pools only (eu-west1, eu-central1), ~12% global traffic overall. Rollback plan: revert to `router-proxy@v1.4.7` immediately if 502s > 0.5% for any 5m window or p95 latency increases > 150ms. Rollback command: ``
/deploy rollback release/router-proxy@v1.4.7 --env=prod
``
Warm-pool fallback (if rollback fails or infra flaps): ``
/ops traffic-shift warmpool-eu --percent=100 --reason="temporary-fallback-1980011222"
``
Logs and traces: https://logs.local/routers/eu-west1/1980011222 and runbook: https://runbooks.local/router-proxy-fallback.md

sre-ana: I can take ops approval. Recommend 10m quiet window at each stage and extra trace sampling. Approving to expedite. :thumbsup:

eng-lead-priya: I approve from eng, but want staged rollout percentages and automated health gates spelled out. No full 100% cut unless green for 20m at 10% stage.

mike: Proposed rollout: 1% start, monitor 5m. If OK -> 10% for 20m. Then 50% for 10m -> 100% if still green. Health gates: abort on 5xx > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 token latency +150ms vs baseline. Alerts go to #eng-oncall and ops-oncall. If abort, either rollback or run warm-pool command.

pm-dan: PM note: linking to incident RED-4810 and updating status page draft. Release note blurb: "Hotfix to revert keepalive window change in router-proxy to address intermittent request failures in EU dedicated routing."

releasebot: Release note draft saved: "router-proxy: revert keepalive tweak -> fixes intermittent 502s in EU (v1.4.8)". PM review requested @pm-dan

deploy-bot: Deploy started: release/router-proxy-hotfix@v1.4.8 -> prod
- step 1: image pull from gcr.io/redwood/router:hotfix-1980011222
- step 2: start new replicas in eu-west1 (warm-pool disabled until health-pass)
- step 3: healthhook verification
Deploy logs: https://deploy.local/1980011222/logs

mike: Staged 1% slice up. Running synthetic stream test + downstream checks.

sre-ana: Synthetic stream test PASS. No uptick in 502s at 1%. Traces look normal.

eng-lead-priya: 1% looks good. Move to 10% when ready.

mike: Moving to 10% now. Will monitor 20m.

ops-oncall-lee: Watching metrics. If any sustained jitter I will invoke warm-pool fallback. :eyes:

(20m passes)
mike: 10% stable, no regression observed. Proceeding to 50%.

releasebot: Note: tagging release with changelog entry and linking to RED-4810 ticket.

mike: 50% slice healthy for 12m. Advancing to 100% per rollout plan.

sre-ana: Metrics look steady. No rollback needed. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall-lee: All clear from ops side. Great job.

mike: Final: hotfix at 100% live. Will keep an elevated watch for next hour and then close RED-4810. Thanks team. :tada:
